newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - USA Detergents raised.

text.p: -- PaineWebber said it upgraded USA Detergents Inc to attractive from neutral.
-- said believes USA Detergents is currently undervalued.
-- said USA Detergents is addressing issues related to its rapid growth and is taking steps to evolve into a larger, stronger company.
-- said the company is taking care of its distribution problems.
-- said the company's market share is growing.
-- expects USA Detergents to earn $1.05 a share for the current fiscal year ending in December and $1.56 a share in the next fiscal year.
